verdict: Organic engagement declining across all brands; paid channels remain offline.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, Google Business Profile was the only active channel this period, producing a combined 424 actions from roughly 1,800 impressions — but momentum is sliding, with GBP actions down 38–42% week over week at Forte and AGS, and 17% at O'Hare, alongside sharp drops in organic search clicks at all three brands. No paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads for any entity during the full 28 days, so there is no paid activity offsetting the organic softness. Several CRM, outreach, and SEO milestones that were due as far back as July and August remain open, and resolving those is the direct path to reactivating the contact sequences and paid programs that drive leads. Work is underway now to clear the open blockers, reindex the three sites, and get outreach sequences live before the end of October.

watch_item.issue: GBP and organic search engagement are declining week over week across all three brands, with no paid activity to offset the drop.
watch_item.fix: SEO root-cause fixes and site reindexing are in progress now, and contact sequences are being prepared to launch this month as the CRM blockers are cleared.
